headline: Zambia Holds Interest Rate at 10.75% as Inflation Stays on Target
summary: The central bank of Zambia maintained its benchmark interest rate at 10.75%, noting that inflation remains on target.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions determine commercial borrowing expenses and govern macroeconomic monetary stability within the country.

impacts.name: Zambia
impacts.why: Keeping interest rates unchanged preserves current monetary policy settings.
